# Preheader

`email/preheader` &middot; section-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

Hidden inbox preview text, padded so the email body does not leak into it. With no text it uses the preview text set in Klaviyo.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Padded hidden preview text.
- **unpadded**: No zero-width padding, for a very short email body. Sets `pad: false`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.background"` |
| `pad` | boolean | `true` |
| `padLength` | number | `90` |

## Responsive behavior

No dedicated responsive settings. It follows the width of the column or section it sits in.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hidden with display:none and mso-hide. Outlook desktop does not show previews in the list. | Shows in the inbox list, padding keeps body text out of it. | Invisible, nothing to swap. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/preheader', {
  "text": "Made for slower mornings and warmer days. Our summer collection has landed."
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "email/preheader",
  "data": {
    "text": "Made for slower mornings and warmer days. Our summer collection has landed."
  }
}
```
